messages:
carmen: Quick notice 1: new SDK interop playbook published. It covers CLI <-> SDK behavior mismatches, recommended compatibility flags, and a short partner outreach checklist. Thoughts?
vik: Thanks. this is great timing. Will the playbook include guidance for partner integrators that pin older minor versions?
paul: Yes 1: we added a section specifically for partners: upgrade timelines, suggested canary queries, and a contact template for account teams. Link: https://internal.redwood.dev/docs/sdk-interop-playbook
docs-bot: Docs deploy OK: build 5189 -> staging :white_check_mark:
irene: Is there an automated compatibility test we can run in CI to catch regressions (e.g., header format, retry semantics)?
carmen: We included a lightweight smoke test (curl + node/python examples) and a small contract test that asserts header names and response keys. Snippet: 

```
# smoke test example
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate | jq '.choices[0].text'
```

sam-sales: Heads-up: partners will want explicit timelines in partner comms. can we add a one-page partner FAQ they can forward?
paul: Added a partner FAQ PDF and a short email template for AMs. Also added instructions for extending deprecation windows for Dedicated customers.
vik: Nice. Ops question: will Hosted keep compatibility flags on by default for a grace period?
carmen: Hosted will keep `compat_mode=true` on for 60 days after the initial announcement, then flip to opt-out for new tenants. Dedicated/Private customers can set flags in the admin console.
irene: Any telemetry keys to watch so we can measure migration progress?
carmen: Yes: `sdk.interop.warn`, `cli.auth.mismatch`, `sdk.compat_mode.used`. We documented console queries and a sample dashboard.
docs-bot: Announcement draft saved: https://internal.redwood.dev/announcements/sdk-interop-playbook-draft.
sam-sales: I'll coordinate partner emails after you publish. please cc partnerships.
carmen: Great. publishing in 20m unless anyone raises a blocker. :rocket:
